description:
Go Young-Do, a middle-aged man living a life of being ignored and marginalized, gets drunk and records a video containing private moments. When that day's video is accidentally live-streamed, his miserable, neglected daily life receives unexpected attention. What seemed like a comforting interest soon begins to steer Go Young-Do's life in an unforeseen direction.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=850749), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14168953)
